selection: same validation macro F1, composite, loss; no test
ranking_rule: Five mean metric deltas versus BP; Strong=all five positive; Acceptable=at least four positive and remaining >= -0.01 absolute; <=2 positives and a drop >.01 is Weak. Report every seed; select no best seed.
pairwise_rule: Explore pairs among top four validation macro-F1 candidates, including mechanistically complementary M1/M2/M3 when singles suggest interaction; show all deltas, never assume synergy
triple_rule: At most top four triples after pairs; no forced claim of three successful innovations
reference_bank: All 798 TRAIN acquisitions, numeric FC upper triangle + age/sex/site; no diagnosis/source features. Self reference masked by Sample_ID during train; same acquisition metadata mask on all roles; no query-query edges.
test: CLOSED until model and ablation decisions frozen
